name: app-lock-screen-widget-on-grey-desk
title: Top-down phone on grey desk with a gradient time widget
whatItIs: A phone lying diagonally on a grey surface beside a yellow object at the top right. The screen shows a greeting, a bold notification headline, a blurred orange-blue gradient orb with the time, and a yellow bottom bar.
whatItMeans: Quiet and modern; the neutral desk lets the small gradient widget feel like the only warm spot.
techniques: Shoot from above on a neutral surface with one colour object nearby.
Use a blurred orange-to-blue orb as a time widget.
Set headlines in tight grotesque bold.
Angle the device diagonally in the frame.

vocabulary.definition: A device photographed from directly above.
A blurred colour sphere used as a clock or status.
A plain grey or beige background.
A coloured object placed in the corner of a scene.
